messages.text: hello, have ethernet ?

Yes — the S1 runs on wired ethernet, so it needs a cable to your router (not included; the Power Kit doesn't ship one either). At 150 W it's about 108 kWh a month, roughly $11 at 10¢.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
first, i have see nexus on bitcoinmerchwith ethernet plug, but ethernet plug is not visible on your foto
Read the nexus s1 10th s page
Searched the catalog · Nexus S1 10TH/s

Good catch, and let me correct myself: the S1's listed spec is WiFi only (2.4 GHz) — no ethernet port. I was wrong earlier, sorry. That matches the photos.

If wired is a must for you, say the word and I'll point you to a unit that takes ethernet. Where will it run — near the router, or further off?
thanks for precisions, yes i need ethernet and possibly BM1373 ASIC chips
Read the bsb b30 page
Read the magic miner 40t page

That's the Harlo B30 — $899, BM1373 chips, 30 TH/s, and the spec lists WiFi and ethernet. Three modes: 18 TH/s at 230 W, 24 at 350, 30 at 485. Ships November 30, 2026.

What do you pay per kWh? I'll run the sats and the power cost for you.
probably i will tray to go on B30 small, is it opensource os and compnent too ?

The listing doesn't state open-source firmware or hardware for the B30, and I won't guess on that. I've passed it to our hardware guy — he picks it up Monday at 10am ET and you'll get the answer by email.

What I can confirm: $899, BM1373, ethernet, ships November 30, 2026.
Handed to the team · Shopper asks whether the Harlo B30 runs open-source firmware/OS and uses open-so
Anything else I can line up for you in the meantime — power cost at your rate, or shipping to your country?
i'm in france, no smaller b30 avaible befor ?
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page

There's only one B30 — one size, $899, ships November 30, 2026.

The closest thing sooner is the Hammer Thor P2: $369, 10 TH/s at 166 W, 2× BM1373, ethernet too. Its ship window was early October, so let me confirm the current date rather than quote a stale one.

For F., note the price excludes 21% import VAT, charged on delivery.
tanks, my mail is (email hidden), i thing that the price include the TVA, need ui pay at deliver time ?

No — the listed price is the unit only. For France, 21% import VAT is charged on delivery by the carrier or customs, plus any duty; we don't collect it at checkout and can't quote the exact figure your customs raises.

Shipping is separate and does show at checkout. So B30 $899 + shipping, then ~21% on delivery.
